def spiral_matrix(size):
    if size == 0:
        return []

    matrix = [[0] * size for _ in range(size)]

    num = 1
    top = 0
    bottom = size - 1
    left = 0
    right = size - 1

    while top <= bottom and left <= right:
        # Fill top row (left to right)
        for col in range(left, right + 1):
            matrix[top][col] = num
            num += 1
        top += 1

        # Fill right column (top to bottom)
        for row in range(top, bottom + 1):
            matrix[row][right] = num
            num += 1
        right -= 1

        # Fill bottom row (right to left)
        # This condition prevents issues when only a single row remains
        # and has already been covered by the top row fill (e.g., for size=1)
        if top <= bottom:
            for col in range(right, left - 1, -1):
                matrix[bottom][col] = num
                num += 1
            bottom -= 1

        # Fill left column (bottom to top)
        # This condition prevents issues when only a single column remains
        # and has already been covered by the right column fill
        if left <= right:
            for row in range(bottom, top - 1, -1):
                matrix[row][left] = num
                num += 1
            left += 1

    return matrix
